prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit this approved CLEAN TUNER two-screen design into a MORE MODERN precise industrial design variation inspired by teenage engineering's reduction, geometric iconography and typographic discipline. This is an original Clean product, NO teenage engineering logos or claims. The user especially likes recognizable instrument silhouettes and rejects both photoreal AI chrome guitar renders and anonymous parallel string arrays. Keep actual recognizable guitar/ukulele headstock shapes. Preserve warm premium champagne silver material, warm ivory surfaces, the accepted three-note RANGE arc meter and existing functionality. TWO matching portrait panels side by side, same frontal framing, exact same readings and note/string mapping.

Primary redesign LOWER HALF: transform the organic hand-drawn-looking guitar and ukulele headstocks into crisp geometric instrument pictograms printed on the panel. Flat warm grey silhouette with a super-fine dark outline. Guitar headstock top is a clean near-horizontal cap with subtly clipped upper corners, straight lightly tapered sides, crisp angled shoulders leading to a narrow straight neck. Ukulele has its own shorter rounded-rectangle cap, tapered sides and short neck. Recognizable instrument proportions, NOT generic rectangles or circuit board. Remove vintage wavy ornamental top curves. Exact symmetric CAD-like linework. Use pure small flat circles for the six guitar tuning handles and four uke tuning handles, outside the silhouette on tiny straight stems. Each handle is a clearly touchable circular pad in ivory with hairline charcoal edge. No chrome/metal reflections, no shadows on pictogram, no screw threads, no mechanical photorealism. Tiny single dot tuning posts inside shape, six fine straight string paths to nut. Compact, precise, controlled geometric styling with breathing room.

Guitar labels: outside left pegs top '4 D₃', middle '5 A₂', bottom '6 E₂'; outside right pegs top '3 G₃', middle '2 B₃', bottom '1 E₄'. EXACT six labels and six pegs. Nut order from viewer left E₂ A₂ D₃ G₃ B₃ E₄. Selected A₂: ONLY middle-left round peg pad is flat restrained signal-orange fill, ONLY middle-left tuning post and its string to SECOND nut slot from viewer left are orange. All other paths and posts grey. Ukulele outside left top '3 C₄', bottom '4 G₄'; outside right top '2 E₄', bottom '1 A₄'. Four pegs only. Nut order G₄ C₄ E₄ A₄. ONLY upper-left round pad and post and second string C₄ orange. No large glow around instrument, sharply controlled orange accent. Numerals tiny monospaced, note names clear sans serif.

Secondary restraint across screen: eliminate ornamental horizontal lines around AUTO and footer; one small aligned 'AUTO' label above diagram sufficient. Retain selector row Guitar / Standard and Ukulele / High G. Keep CLEAN TUNER header and single small settings icon. Slightly shallower inset bezel, single precise edge instead of stacked chrome borders, retain subtle premium champagne texture. Refine type to clean modern neo-grotesque with small technical monospace micro-labels. Meter remains soft translucent three-zone ivory arch with tiny boundary seams, NOT ticks or fixed center lines. It can retain subtle amber light, linking to orange selected pad. Left A₂ target -8 ct FLAT, right C₄ 0 ct IN TUNE. Left orange actual-pitch indicator about 4 degrees left of apex, not wildly off-center. Listening tiny status dot, never a button. No extra controls, no fake serial numbers, no decorative labels, no wood, no retro panel, no dark theme. This should look like a carefully authored modern boutique music utility with simple charming geometric instrument illustrations, not a photoreal toy guitar.
status: Alternative concept; approved linework predecessor preserved
review: Correct labels and selected string routing. Actual pitch indicator position remains schematic; calibrate in implementation.
